stem: What is meant by the term 'Umland'?

options.label: a
options.text: The heart area of a town

expl: An Umland is an area surrounding a town. An Umland refers to the environs of a city town or village, that is the part of the main community through common economic and cultural activities. The term was first used by Daniel Saunders in 1883 but the term was highlighted by Andre Allix, a French geographer in 1914.

stem: Who was the first to use the word 'Megalopolis'?
